title: RecipeExtractionValidation
description: Full validation schema for extracted recipe JSON. Not sent to Claude — Claude's json_schema output format doesn't support if/then/else, allOf, or contains, so those keywords live here instead, alongside the stricter string/numeric constraints that Claude's structured outputs also don't support. Run this with a standard JSON Schema validator (e.g. Python's jsonschema library) against the output of recipe-extraction.schema.json.

title.description: Required. The name of the recipe as stated in the source document.

ingredients.description: Required. The list of ingredient lines as stated in the source document.

category.description: Required. The best-fitting category for the recipe. Use 'other' when none of the fixed values fit, and describe it in category_other_detail.

category_other_detail.description: Required, nullable. Free-text category label from the source document, e.g. a German category string that doesn't map to the fixed enum. Must be non-null when category is 'other', and must be null for every other category value.

servings.description: Required, nullable. Number of servings/portions the recipe yields. Null if not stated in the source document.

prep_time_minutes.description: Required, nullable. Total preparation time in minutes. Null if not stated in the source document.

calories_kcal.description: Required, nullable. Calories per serving in kcal. Null if not stated in the source document.

detail.description: Free-text description for this entry, e.g. a German flag string that doesn't map to the fixed values. Must be non-null when value is 'other', and must be null otherwise.

dietary_flags.description: Required, may be empty. Dietary/allergen flags that apply to the recipe, as stated in the source document. 'vegan' and 'vegetarian' should each appear at most once, with detail null. Add one entry with value 'other' for each distinct stated flag that doesn't map to the fixed values (e.g. 'glutenfrei' and 'laktosefrei' would be two separate 'other' entries), each with its own detail.
